This page has no article, main, or role attributes at all. The extractor must fall back to text density analysis to find this block, because it contains the longest continuous prose on the page. Density-based selection looks for the container with the most paragraph text and the fewest navigation links, which is exactly what this section is designed to represent in the test suite.

A second paragraph adds more weight to this container so that the scoring heuristic clearly prefers it over the shorter decorative blocks around it.
